capabilities: normalize pasted Markdown and LaTeX automatically
normalize complete math expressions on Enter
normalize the active note when it is opened
protect fenced code blocks and inline code from edits
run manual commands on selections, last paste, or clipboard
extras: Not yet published to the Community Plugins directory; installation is described as intended for development and testing. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Copying math from Gemini Notebook produces inconsistent Markdown and LaTeX that Obsidian users must clean up by hand.

relations.evidence: normalizes LaTeX and Markdown copied from Gemini Notebook

summary: Normalizer that cleans and standardizes LaTeX and Markdown content copied from Gemini Notebook into consistent mathematical notes.
